# Test fixtures

Every fixture here is **hand-crafted** and **byte-explainable**. No fixture is generated by the code under test (circular dependency).

Each fixture's bytes are documented below so a reviewer can verify by inspection what the parser is expected to produce.

---

## `mapbin/`

Hand-crafted `map.bin` files exercising every documented branch of the encoding.

### `mapbin/3x2_basic.bin`

A 3×2 layout (6 tiles, 12 bytes). Covers: minimum metatile id, mid-range metatile id, all collision values, all elevation values (low/mid/max), and a "max-everything" tile.

| (x,y) | metatile_id | collision | elevation | packed uint16 | bytes (LE) |
|-------|-------------|-----------|-----------|---------------|------------|
| (0,0) | 0x001       | 0         | 0         | `0x0001`      | `01 00`    |
| (1,0) | 0x002       | 1         | 0         | `0x0402`      | `02 04`    |
| (2,0) | 0x003       | 0         | 2         | `0x2003`      | `03 20`    |
| (0,1) | 0x004       | 2         | 0         | `0x0804`      | `04 08`    |
| (1,1) | 0x3FF       | 3         | 0xF       | `0xFFFF`      | `FF FF`    |
| (2,1) | 0x000       | 0         | 0         | `0x0000`      | `00 00`    |

Full bytestring (12 bytes, hex):

```
01 00 02 04 03 20 04 08 FF FF 00 00
```

This fixture is built deterministically at test time (see `tests/fixtures/mapbin/build.py`) so the bytes on disk are always traceable to this table — but the bytes are also asserted directly in the tests, not loaded from disk, to keep tests hermetic.
